title: Malacañang urges budget watchdogs: Submit ‘red flags’ on 2027 budget
summary: MANILA – Malacañang called on budget watchdogs to submit the “red flags” in the House-approved proposed 2027 national budget, emphasizing their role in helping the government to protect public funds.
